annotations.title: Quote a video with motion clips

description: The exact credit price of a video with AI motion clips BEFORE it is made, and whether this account may make it. Read-only: nothing is created, reserved or charged, and no prompt is checked. approxUsd is totalCredits in USD at what a credit costs this account, and approxUsdBasis says how it is worked out. Returns baseCredits (the normal video), motionCredits (115 credits per motion scene, each a 5-second clip, on top of the normal video price), totalCredits, the balance and whether it covers the total, maxMotionScenes and, when it cannot be made, code + reason (MOTION_CLIPS_DISABLED: the feature is switched off). There is no plan or trial limit: enough credits is the only account condition. Motion scenes that cannot be made fall back to a still image with their credits refunded. Pass the same motion_scenes to create_video. Requires the "video:read" scope.

language.description: Optional BCP-47 code (e.g. "en", "fa"). A language only ElevenLabs speaks adds its voice premium to baseCredits.

motion_scenes.description: How many scenes to price as AI clips (default 1).
